items_all.title: State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away
items_all.summary: Nous Research retrained Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to produce Arete-27B, largely stripping out its pro-Chinese bias. The propaganda rate dropped from 22 percent to less than one percent, while general capabilities remained intact in tests. The method relied on 53 million tokens of supervised fine-tuning. The political bias is "applied late, it is applied thin," the team writes. The article State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM
items_all.summary: Buoyant has released Kinference, an Apache 2.0 inference control plane for vLLM on Kubernetes. It adds declarative routing policies, KV-cache-aware load balancing and per-tenant metrics, and cut median TTFT 95% in Buoyant’s own benchmark. The post Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Buoyant 推出了 Kinference，這是一個針對 Kubernetes 上 vLLM 的 Apache 2.0 推論控制平面。它加入了宣告式路由策略、感知 KV 快取（KV-cache-aware）的負載平衡以及按租戶劃分的指標，並在 Buoyant 自身的效能測試中將中位數 TTFT 降低了 95%。

items_all_raw.title: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
items_all_raw.summary: Google Research built an AI that spots signs of high blood pressure using only the pulse and motion sensors in a standard smartwatch, no cuff needed. In a 196-person study, its 65.8 percent detection rate beat the traditional in-office measurement. The method is already live in the Google Health app, though it doesn't replace a formal diagnosis. The article Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google Research 開發出了一款人工智慧，僅需透過標準智慧手錶中的脈搏與動作感測器就能偵測高血壓跡象，不需要使用壓脈帶。在一項 196 人的研究中，其 65.8% 的檢測率超越了傳統的診所測量方式。該方法已在 Google Health 應用程式中上線，儘管它無法取代正式診斷。

items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI has secured $11 billion in fresh capital, the first tranche of a round that values the company at $1.25 trillion. The full round could swell to $20 billion. That OpenAI is already turning to wealthy private investors hints at a saturating AI capital market and growing investor caution. The article OpenAI lands an $11 billion funding round, but has to court dentists for more capital appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all_raw.title: Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM
items_all_raw.summary: Buoyant has released Kinference, an Apache 2.0 inference control plane for vLLM on Kubernetes. It adds declarative routing policies, KV-cache-aware load balancing and per-tenant metrics, and cut median TTFT 95% in Buoyant’s own benchmark. The post Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Buoyant 推出了 Kinference，這是一個針對 Kubernetes 上 vLLM 的 Apache 2.0 推論控制平面。它加入了宣告式路由策略、感知 KV 快取（KV-cache-aware）的負載平衡以及按租戶劃分的指標，並在 Buoyant 自身的效能測試中將中位數 TTFT 降低了 95%。

items_all_raw.title: Quoting Nilay Patel
items_all_raw.summary: The products aren't good enough to sell people on the costs. You cannot tell people that you have to listen to the whine of a data center in their backyard for AI overviews and some of the most hilarious deep fake slop in history. It's not worth it. It just isn't worth it to anyone. And agents aren't real and they might not be being used the way that anyone wants them to yet. All these companies are spending more than they're making on these products. Refrigerators holding blood storage in Europe are being hacked. The costs are too high. The benefits are not real. And if you connect that to corruption, you're like, in order to impose these costs on me, these CEOs are in the White House shaking Trump's hand, renaming it to the Gulf of America, paying for this ballroom that we don't want. It's obvious crypto-corruption, and it's still slop. The AI industry will not get out of it until they make better products . Until everyone can see without needing to be convinced, without needing an ad campaign, without any of this stuff that just using these products makes your life better. — Nilay Patel , The Vergecast: Big Tech lost big in the 2026 election Tags: nilay-patel , slop , ai , generative-ai , ai-ethics
